request_fields.project_id: TimelineSession.open resolves runtime.project and writes canonical session.project_id
request_fields.timeline_id: TimelineSession.open resolves 'film' and writes canonical session.timeline_id
request_fields.base_revision_id: runtime.base or explicit pins are installed as the outbox base; no head refresh is performed
request_fields.base_publication_id: runtime.base or explicit pins are installed as the outbox base; no head refresh is performed
request_fields.commands: JSON file bytes decode to the authored command list; commit_many deep-copies/validates and preserves command-level rationale, expect and reads
request_fields.label: omitted by this ABI-1 semantic caller, so commit_many applies its compatibility default 'Timeline edit'
request_fields.steps: omitted by this ABI-1 semantic caller, so commit_many synthesizes steps from command order
request_fields.merge: omitted, so commit_many uses the supported default 'fields'
request_fields.reads: no request-level reads are authored in root-045; command-level reads/guards remain inside commands
request_fields.idempotency: --idempotency-key is extracted only when supplied and forwarded unchanged; absent retries reuse the persisted flight key
request_fields.dry_run: --dry-run is converted to the boolean argument and becomes the persisted request field
request_fields.source: via='cli' is passed unchanged and _flush writes source={'via':'cli'}
request_fields.rationale: command-level rationale remains in commands; no top-level rationale is authored by root-045
request_fields.group_id: not authored by root-045 and not synthesized

reply_fields.success: {'ok': True, **accepted} preserves the complete TimelineSession {data, receipt, idempotency_key} result
reply_fields.refusal: local/provider errors retain code/message/details; no Runtime request is sent for preflight refusals
reply_fields.preview: accepted result is preserved and the underlying _ack requires status=preview and receipt=null

envelope_boundary.extra_fields: the adapter does not unwrap-and-ignore a dict envelope; it refuses it, preserving the no-call/no-history/file-bytes predicate
envelope_boundary.decision: no C0 envelope field is silently discarded in an accepted root-045 case

static_comparison.file_bytes: all authored command/file assertions remain in place
static_comparison.base_pair: explicit in all lost-ack/original-pair cases and asserted in outgoing request
